ryan-alport.name: Ryan Alport
ryan-alport.detail: Our fearless leader. Started the club and does many of the presentations. Also the genius behind the stylesheet. "You're welcome."

armen-deroian.name: Armen Deroian
armen-deroian.detail: Unreasonably cracked and also handsome. Physics, game dev, you name it, Armen does it better than you.

kyle-butel.name: Kyle Butel
kyle-butel.detail: Kyle studies architecture but he dabbles in various areas of software development. He is an extraordinarily lean and athletic member of the team.

nicholas-columbus.name: Nicholas Columbus
nicholas-columbus.detail: Our resident cyber security expert and generally pretty funny guy. Nick has worked in sys admin, web dev, games, education, content, and more. Go read his newsletter!

aruntej-thummepally.name: Aruntej Thummepally
aruntej-thummepally.detail: Possibly our most handsome member. Arun schools everyone in every class but he is too humble to admit that. He is a master of his craft and a true gentleman.

aidan-lowell.name: Aidan Lowell
aidan-lowell.detail: Aidan is a Biomedical Engineering student and vibe coding extraordinaire. He focuses on full stack mobile app development as well as being our tallest and sweetest presenter.
